title: Outline feature properties, version 2
description: Properties every feature in outlines/<record-id>.geojson carries. Geometry is WGS84 (EPSG:4326). A feature is one wellbore (Point), one survey or field (Polygon or MultiPolygon) or one line (LineString). Version 2 requires the input identity on derived features (approximate: false); every version-1 placeholder still validates.

approximate.description: true when the geometry is a placeholder (centroid, hand-drawn box) and not derived from the data; the map draws it differently and L3 requires false

source.description: How the geometry was derived: the extractor and the input name of its rule in src/osd/outlines/rules.yaml, or 'hand placed from publisher map' for a placeholder

publisher_id.description: The publisher's own identifier for the wellbore or survey

input_url.description: The record input the geometry was derived from

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the input's SHA256SUMS (one sha256sum line per fetched part, in fetch order)

licence.description: The licence of the record the geometry was derived from (OSD-D13)
